tomato.affected_plant_part: Leaves, flower buds, green and ripe fruits
tomato.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore round circular holes into tomato fruits and feed while keeping anterior body inside and posterior outside; fruits rot and drop prematurely.
tomato.favourable_conditions: Warm days (26-32°C), moderate relative humidity, presence of alternate hosts.
tomato.affected_diseases: None directly transmitted (bore holes predispose fruits to secondary soft rot)
tomato.management: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma chilonis @ 50,000/ha; spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L (PHI: 3 days) or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.
tomato.prevention: Intercrop with African Marigold (1 row marigold for every 16 rows tomato) as trap crop; install pheromone traps (Helilure @ 5/acre).

tomato.affected_plant_part: Underside of tender leaves, growing shoots
tomato.damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck cell sap from leaf undersides causing chlorotic stippling and downward leaf curling; heavy honeydew excretion leads to black sooty mold.
tomato.favourable_conditions: Warm dry conditions (28-35°C), low relative humidity (<60%).
tomato.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
tomato.management: Spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L; spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2g/L.
tomato.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20/acre) at canopy level; grow border crop of 2 rows of maize or pearl millet as live barrier.

paddy.affected_plant_part: Central tillers, growing shoot, panicle base
paddy.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in vegetative tillers; white heads (chaffy, empty panicles) at heading stage.
paddy.favourable_conditions: Warm humid weather (25-30°C), dense planting, continuous waterlogging.
paddy.affected_diseases: None directly transmitted (wounds permit fungal entry)
paddy.management: Release Trichogramma japonicum @ 100,000/ha; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP @ 2g/L.
paddy.prevention: Install pheromone traps (Scirpo-lure @ 5/acre); clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting to remove egg masses.

paddy.damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck sap at stem base causing circular patches of dry brown plants (hopper burn).
paddy.favourable_conditions: High humidity, close planting, excess nitrogen, stagnant water.
paddy.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
paddy.affected_diseases: Rice Grassy Stunt Virus, Rice Ragged Stunt Virus
paddy.management: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD); drain field; spray Triflumezopyrim 10% SC @ 0.5ml/L or Pymetrozine 50% WG @ 0.6g/L.
paddy.prevention: Create 30cm alley ways every 2.5m; use BPH-tolerant varieties; avoid excessive urea.

chilli.affected_plant_part: Tender leaves, growing buds, flower petals
chilli.damage_symptoms: Leaves curl upwards (boat-shaped); crinkling of foliage with bronze coloration on undersurface; vector of Chilli Leaf Curl Virus.
chilli.favourable_conditions: Warm dry weather with clear skies.
chilli.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
chilli.management: Spray Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.8ml/L or Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L.
chilli.prevention: Install blue sticky traps (15/acre); grow maize or sorghum as live windbreak border.

chilli.damage_symptoms: Leaves curl downwards (inverted boat); elongation of petiole (rat-tail symptom); leaves turn deep green and brittle.
chilli.favourable_conditions: Humid cloudy weather with warm temperatures.
chilli.management: Spray Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Wettable Sulphur 80% WP @ 3g/L or Abamectin 1.9% EC @ 0.75ml/L.
chilli.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer; spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L preventively.

cotton.damage_symptoms: Rosetted flower buds; larvae bore into young bolls, feeding on seeds and staining lint; premature boll opening.
cotton.favourable_conditions: Late vegetative and reproductive phase, warm humid nights.
cotton.affected_diseases: Predisposes bolls to boll rot fungi (Aspergillus, Colletotrichum)
cotton.management: Install Gossyplure pheromone traps @ 5/acre for monitoring (8/trap/day = ETL); spray Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.8ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5g/L.
cotton.prevention: Plant non-Bt refuge; terminate crop by mid-January to break pest life cycle; avoid ratoon cotton.

cotton.damage_symptoms: Chlorotic stippling on leaf surface; severe honeydew secretion resulting in black sooty mold; vector of Cotton Leaf Curl Virus.
cotton.favourable_conditions: Hot dry weather, excessive synthetic pyrethroid sprays.
cotton.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
cotton.management: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2g/L or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 2ml/L; spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
cotton.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps @ 15/acre; avoid resurgence-causing insecticides.

sugarcane.affected_plant_part: Growing points of young shoots (1-3 months)
sugarcane.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in mother shoots and tillers during first 90 days; foul smell when pulled; base shows tiny entry hole.
sugarcane.favourable_conditions: High temperatures (35-42°C) and low humidity during summer months.
sugarcane.management: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma chilonis @ 50,000/ha at 10-day intervals; soil drenching of Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 1.5ml/L along cane furrow.
sugarcane.prevention: Trash mulching (10-15cm thick) @ 3 tonnes/ha within 3 days of planting; earthing up at 45 days.

sugarcane.damage_symptoms: Dense white woolly waxy colonies on lower leaf surface; leaves turn yellow and dry; copious honeydew leads to thick black sooty mold.
sugarcane.favourable_conditions: Humid tropical climate, dense vegetative canopy.
sugarcane.management: Conserve or release predator Dipha aphidivora / Micromus igorotus; spot spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Acephate 75% SP @ 1.5g/L on lower leaves.
sugarcane.prevention: Avoid excessive nitrogen; de-trash lower 3-4 dry leaves.

maize.affected_plant_part: Whorl leaves, tassel, silk, developing cobs
maize.damage_symptoms: Ragged leaves with pinholes, extensive windowing of whorl leaves packed with copious sawdust-like frass.
maize.favourable_conditions: Warm weather (24-32°C), late sown maize, humid cloudy days.
maize.affected_diseases: Predisposes cobs to Aspergillus ear rot
maize.management: Whorl application of sand + lime mixture (9:1); spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5ml/L.
maize.prevention: Install FAW pheromone traps @ 5/acre; plant border rows of cowpea or sorghum; practice timely synchronous sowing.

maize.damage_symptoms: Parallel pinhole rows across unfolding leaves; dead heart formation in young seedlings.
maize.favourable_conditions: Moderately high temperature, low humidity during crop establishment.
maize.management: Release Trichogramma chilonis @ 175,000/ha; apply carbofuran 3% CG @ 5kg/ha into whorls.
maize.prevention: Destroy stubbles after harvest; intercrop with cowpea.

coconut.damage_symptoms: V-shaped geometric cuts on opened fronds; holes bored into crown base plugged with chewed fiber; destroyed growing tips.
coconut.favourable_conditions: Presence of decomposing farmyard manure or dead palm trunks nearby.
coconut.affected_diseases: Bore holes predispose palm to deadly Red Palm Weevil and fungal bud rot
coconut.management: Hook out beetles from crown with curved iron hook; place naphthalene balls (3 balls) covered with fine sand in top leaf axils; apply Metarhizium anisopliae to manure pits.
coconut.prevention: Treat breeding manure heaps with Metarhizium anisopliae @ 5x10^11 spores/m3; install Oryctalure pheromone traps @ 1/ha.

coconut.damage_symptoms: Oozing of viscous brown fluid from trunk holes; chewed fibrous frass ejected; gnawing sound heard from trunk; central spindle wilts.
coconut.favourable_conditions: Palms aged 5-20 years with pruning cuts or beetle damage.
coconut.management: Trunk injection of Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (3-5 ml in 10-15 ml water) or stem furrow treatment; seal all wounds with coal tar.
coconut.prevention: Install Ferrolure pheromone bucket traps @ 1/ha with food bait (pineapple/toddy); never cut green fronds within 120cm of base.

coffee.affected_plant_part: Main stem and thick primary branches of Arabica coffee
coffee.damage_symptoms: Ridiged rings on stem bark; yellowing and wilting of foliage; plants easily break at ground level; wood full of compact frass tunnels.
coffee.favourable_conditions: Exposed unshaded coffee bushes, warm sunny post-monsoon months (October-December and April-May).
coffee.management: Trace, uproot and burn infested plants (tracing); swab main stem with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 6ml/L with wetting agent in April and October.
coffee.prevention: Maintain two-tier canopy shade (40-50% filtered sunlight); stem wrapping with gunny/polythene sheets during flight season.
coffee.source: Coffee Board of India Research Dept & TNAU

coffee.affected_plant_part: Green, ripe and dry coffee berries
coffee.damage_symptoms: Pin-sized entrance hole drilled into navel (calyx) region of berry; beans hollowed out and powderized.
coffee.favourable_conditions: High relative humidity, unharvested berries left on bush.
coffee.management: Spray Beauveria bassiana @ 1x10^8 conidia/ml at berry development; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L if infestation >10%.
coffee.prevention: Gleaning (clean harvest leaving no berries on plants or ground); install Brocap alcohol traps @ 20/ha.

ragi.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in vegetative phase; earheads become chaffy and white in reproductive phase.
ragi.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L if dead hearts exceed 5%.
ragi.prevention: Early synchronous sowing; pull and burn infested dead-heart tillers.

ragi.damage_symptoms: Dense colonies on earheads sucking sap; honeydew secretion leads to sooty mold and shriveled grains.
ragi.favourable_conditions: Dry spells followed by overcast conditions.
ragi.management: Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
ragi.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps (10/acre); conserve ladybird beetles and syrphid flies.

sorghum.affected_plant_part: Young seedlings up to 30 days, central leaf
sorghum.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in 1-4 week old seedlings; decaying central whorl emits foul rot odor when pulled.
sorghum.favourable_conditions: Late sowings in monsoon, high humidity with moderate temperatures.
sorghum.management: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70% WS @ 5g/kg; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L on seedling stage.
sorghum.prevention: Complete sowing within 10-15 days of monsoon onset; adopt higher seed rate (12 kg/ha) and thin out dead hearts.

pearl_millet.damage_symptoms: Dead heart formation in 2-4 week old crop; rotting whorl leaf comes out easily.
pearl_millet.management: Seed treatment with Thiamethoxam 30% FS @ 4ml/kg; spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L.
pearl_millet.prevention: Sow synchronously with first monsoon shower; increase seed rate and rogue infested seedlings.

foxtail_millet.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in young shoots, causing excessive tillering and stunted head formation.
foxtail_millet.favourable_conditions: Late onset of rains, delayed sowing.
foxtail_millet.management: Spray Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L at 15 DAS.
foxtail_millet.prevention: Early uniform sowing; intercrop with pulses.

little_millet.damage_symptoms: Withered dried central shoot (dead heart) in young plants 2 to 4 weeks after emergence.
little_millet.favourable_conditions: Late kharif sowings, warm humid breaks.
little_millet.management: Spray NSKE 5% at 15 and 25 days after sowing; ensure clean cultivation.
little_millet.prevention: Complete sowing within 15 days of first soaking rain; remove dead-heart plants.

kodo_millet.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts in early stage, chaffy white panicles during earhead emergence.
kodo_millet.management: Spray Neem oil 3000 ppm @ 3ml/L; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L if severe.
kodo_millet.prevention: Burn leftover crop stubbles; rotate with red gram or groundnut.

barnyard_millet.damage_symptoms: Central leaf drying and dead heart formation in seedlings 15 to 30 days after sowing.
barnyard_millet.management: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 600 FS @ 5ml/kg; spray NSKE 5%.
barnyard_millet.prevention: Timely sowing with onset of monsoon; remove affected tillers.

proso_millet.damage_symptoms: Dead hearts and excessive profuse tillering without productive panicles.
proso_millet.management: Foliar spray of Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L at 14 and 28 days.

wheat.damage_symptoms: Dense colonies sucking sap from leaves and earheads; plants turn yellow and produce shriveled, light grains.
wheat.favourable_conditions: Cool, cloudy, humid weather during January-February in North/Central/South India.
wheat.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
wheat.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L at economic threshold (>5 aphids/earhead).
wheat.prevention: Conserve natural predators (Coccinella septempunctata ladybird beetles); avoid excessive nitrogen.

wheat.damage_symptoms: Plants dry up in patches; damaged roots show hollowed tunnels filled with soil particles.
wheat.favourable_conditions: Sandy or light dry soils, un-decomposed FYM.
wheat.management: Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 4ml/kg; drench affected patches with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 3ml/L.
wheat.prevention: Use only well-decomposed FYM; deep summer ploughing.

red_gram.damage_symptoms: Defoliation during vegetative phase; round holes bored into pods with head inside and body outside; damaged empty pods.
red_gram.favourable_conditions: Warm dry days with cool nights during flowering and podding.
red_gram.management: Spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2ml/L.
red_gram.prevention: Install Helilure pheromone traps (5/acre); intercrop with sorghum or maize (4:1) as bird perches.

red_gram.damage_symptoms: Maggots feed internally on seeds without external pod holes; exit pinholes visible only when adult emerges.
red_gram.favourable_conditions: Long duration cultivars, cloudy humid conditions during late flowering.
red_gram.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L at 50% flowering stage.

black_gram.damage_symptoms: Sap sucking produces leaf chlorosis; vector of devastating yellow mosaic virus.
black_gram.favourable_conditions: Warm dry weather (30-36°C) during vegetative growth.
black_gram.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
black_gram.management: Spray Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2g/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L; neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
black_gram.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps (15/acre); seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70% WS @ 5g/kg.

green_gram.damage_symptoms: Sap drainage, honeydew secretion, vector of Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus.
green_gram.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
green_gram.management: Foliar spray of Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L.
green_gram.prevention: Yellow sticky traps @ 12-15/acre; grow MYMV-tolerant cultivars (e.g. VBN 4, CO 8).

bengal_gram.damage_symptoms: Young caterpillars skeletonize leaves; older larvae bore circular holes into pods to consume seeds.
bengal_gram.favourable_conditions: Warm sunny days after winter showers, vegetative and podding stages.
bengal_gram.management: Spray HaNPV 250 LE/ha; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.
bengal_gram.prevention: Install pheromone traps (5/acre); erect bird perches (20/acre); intercrop with coriander or mustard.

cowpea.damage_symptoms: Dense black aphid colonies curling tender leaves and stunting plant growth; vector of mosaic viruses.
cowpea.favourable_conditions: Cloudy humid weather during early vegetative growth.
cowpea.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
cowpea.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L or Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
cowpea.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps; avoid excess nitrogen.

field_bean.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into buds and green pods, sealing the entry hole with silk and faecal pellets.
field_bean.favourable_conditions: Cool humid winter evenings during flowering.
field_bean.management: Spray Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L at flower initiation.
field_bean.prevention: Install light traps; spray neem seed extract 5% at bud burst.

groundnut.damage_symptoms: Small translucent blister mines on leaves; later leaflets webbed together and skeletonized, giving burnt appearance.
groundnut.favourable_conditions: Rainfall deficit, prolonged dry spells in kharif/rabi.
groundnut.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
groundnut.prevention: Install light traps and pheromone traps; intercrop with pearl millet or cumbu (4:1).

groundnut.damage_symptoms: Mass gregarious feeding of hairy reddish-brown caterpillars defoliating entire crop canopy.
groundnut.favourable_conditions: Early monsoon rains in sandy soils of South India.
groundnut.management: Dig trenches (30cm deep) around fields and dust with methyl parathion 2%; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2.5ml/L.
groundnut.prevention: Organize community bonfires / light traps on first rain nights to catch emerging moths.

sesame.damage_symptoms: Tender leaves webbed together; larvae feed inside web and bore into capsules, resulting in empty seedless pods.
sesame.favourable_conditions: Warm humid climate with intermittent sunshine.
sesame.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L at flowering.
sesame.prevention: Clip and destroy webbed shoot tips during early infestation; deep summer ploughing.

sunflower.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars feed on disc florets and bore into developing seeds, lining head with dark excreta.
sunflower.favourable_conditions: Sunny warm weather during ray-floret opening and seed-filling stages.
sunflower.affected_diseases: Predisposes capitulum to Rhizopus head rot
sunflower.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L directly on heads.
sunflower.prevention: Install pheromone traps @ 5/acre; erect bird perches.

castor.damage_symptoms: Voracious defoliation leaving only midribs and main veins; plants completely stripped of foliage.
castor.management: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma chilonis @ 50,000/ha; spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2g/L or Profenofos 50% EC @ 2ml/L.
castor.prevention: Handpick early instar semiloopers; install light traps for moths.

safflower.damage_symptoms: Dense black colonies covering stems; sap suction leads to stunting, poor capitulum development and yield loss up to 70%.
safflower.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L at aphid colonization.
safflower.prevention: Early sowing in October to escape peak aphid population; conserve ladybird beetles.

soybean.damage_symptoms: Female cuts two parallel circular girdles on petiole or stem; foliage above girdle withers, dries, and drops.
soybean.favourable_conditions: High relative humidity with warm temperatures during July-August.
soybean.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Thiamethoxam 12.6% + Lambda-cyhalothrin 9.5% ZC @ 0.3ml/L.
soybean.prevention: Collect and destroy cut withered petioles; rotate crop with maize or sorghum.

tobacco.damage_symptoms: Early instars skeletonize leaf lamina gregariously; older larvae defoliate large irregular patches leaving only midribs.
tobacco.management: Spray SlNPV @ 250 LE/ha with 1% jaggery; spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
tobacco.prevention: Install Spodolure pheromone traps @ 5/acre; plant castor as border trap crop.

brinjal.affected_plant_part: Terminal shoots, flower buds, developing fruits
brinjal.damage_symptoms: Withering and drooping of terminal shoots in vegetative phase; bore holes plugged with excreta in fruits.
brinjal.favourable_conditions: High temperature and high humidity during flowering and fruiting.
brinjal.affected_diseases: None directly transmitted (bore holes cause secondary fruit rot)
brinjal.management: Continuous prompt clipping of withered shoots; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.
brinjal.prevention: Install Lucinlure pheromone traps @ 12/acre; destroy wild Solanum weeds.

onion.damage_symptoms: Silvery white patches and sunken chlorotic spots on leaves; leaf tips turn brown, curl and wither.
onion.favourable_conditions: Dry warm weather; dry spells during rabi season.
onion.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
onion.management: Spray Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5ml/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3g/L with non-ionic sticker.
onion.prevention: Install blue or yellow sticky traps @ 15/acre; sprinkler irrigation reduces thrips count.

okra.damage_symptoms: Terminal shoot drooping; bore holes in fruit sealed with frass; deformed, crooked fruits unsuitable for market.
okra.favourable_conditions: Humid cloudy weather, overlapping summer/monsoon crops.
okra.management: Prompt collection and destruction of infested shoots/fruits; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
okra.prevention: Install Ervitlure pheromone traps @ 5/acre; rogue out alternate hosts (Malvaceae weeds).

okra.damage_symptoms: Vectors destructive Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus; causes leaf chlorosis and sooty mold.
okra.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
okra.management: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2g/L.
okra.prevention: Use YVMV resistant varieties (Arka Anamika, Parbhani Kranti); yellow sticky traps @ 15/acre.

potato.damage_symptoms: Larvae mine leaves and bore into stems; tunnel into tubers in field and storage leaving black frass.
potato.favourable_conditions: Warm dry climate, shallow planting with exposed tubers.
potato.management: Earthing up to prevent tuber exposure; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L in field; store tubers covered with 2.5cm sand.
potato.prevention: Install PTM pheromone traps @ 5/acre; use certified seed tubers.

tapioca.damage_symptoms: Sap draining; major vector of Cassava Mosaic Disease producing distorted, stunted mosaic leaves.
tapioca.favourable_conditions: Warm dry weather with dry soil conditions.
tapioca.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
tapioca.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L; spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
tapioca.prevention: Select CMD-free healthy planting setts; install yellow sticky traps.

sweet_potato.damage_symptoms: Grubs and adult weevils tunnel into tubers and vines; infested tubers turn dark, emit foul terpene odor, and become unpalatable.
sweet_potato.favourable_conditions: Dry season, light soils with cracks exposing tubers.
sweet_potato.management: Dip vine cuttings in Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L for 10 min before planting; spray Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5ml/L.
sweet_potato.prevention: Frequent earthing up to seal soil cracks; install Cylas-lure pheromone traps @ 5/acre.

drumstick.damage_symptoms: Hairy caterpillars congregate in large masses on tree trunks during day and defoliate entire canopy at night.
drumstick.management: Burn caterpillar clusters on trunk using torch; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L or Dichlorvos 76% EC @ 1ml/L.
drumstick.prevention: Deep ploughing in tree basins to expose pupae; light traps.

cucumber.damage_symptoms: Female punctures fruit to lay eggs; maggots feed on internal pulp; fruits rot, deform, and drop.
cucumber.management: Install cue-lure pheromone traps @ 8-10/acre; bait spray of Malathion 50% EC (2ml) + Jaggery (10g) per litre of water on border plants.
cucumber.prevention: Collect and destroy fallen punctured fruits; bag fruits on vine.

pumpkin.damage_symptoms: Adults feed voraciously on cotyledons and leaves making circular holes; grubs feed underground on roots causing seedling collapse.
pumpkin.favourable_conditions: Sunny warm weather during February-April and rainy season.
pumpkin.management: Dust wood ash on seedling leaves early morning; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L or Carbaryl 50% WP @ 2g/L.
pumpkin.prevention: Deep summer ploughing to expose hibernating beetles and grubs; hand collection of sluggish morning beetles.

pumpkin.damage_symptoms: Oviposition punctures ooze fluid; maggots feed inside causing watery pulp decay and premature fruit drop.
pumpkin.favourable_conditions: Warm humid climate with high fruit load.
pumpkin.management: Install cue-lure traps @ 10/acre; spray bait solution of Jaggery 10g + Malathion 50% EC 2ml/L.
pumpkin.prevention: Bury infested rotten fruits 60cm deep; avoid staggered cucurbit cultivation.

bitter_gourd.damage_symptoms: Resinous puncture marks on fruits; maggots feed on seeds and pulp, causing fruit deformation and rotting.
bitter_gourd.management: Install cue-lure traps @ 10/acre; bait spray (10g jaggery + 2ml Malathion 50% EC / litre).
bitter_gourd.prevention: Cover tender fruits with newspaper bags; bury dropped fruits.

bottle_gourd.damage_symptoms: Shot holes on leaves; grubs damage root system underground causing wilting.
bottle_gourd.management: Dust wood ash on foliage; spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L.
bottle_gourd.prevention: Handpick beetles early morning; deep summer ploughing.

ridge_gourd.damage_symptoms: Puncture punctures on fruit ridges; larvae tunnel through internal flesh causing rot and premature drop.
ridge_gourd.management: Install cue-lure traps @ 8/acre; spray bait solution of jaggery + Malathion.

beans.damage_symptoms: Stunted growth, crinkled leaves, sticky honeydew attracting sooty mold.
beans.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
beans.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L; spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
beans.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps; maintain good field hygiene.

cabbage.damage_symptoms: Windowing of leaf lamina with whitish transparent patches; older caterpillars make irregular holes in inner leaves.
cabbage.favourable_conditions: Dry warm conditions (25-32°C), absence of heavy rainfall.
cabbage.management: Intercrop with Indian Mustard (2 rows for every 25 rows cabbage) as trap crop; spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
cabbage.prevention: Install DBM pheromone traps @ 5/acre; avoid repeated use of synthetic pyrethroids due to high insecticide resistance.

cauliflower.damage_symptoms: Window-paning of leaves, feeding on curd surface causing discoloration and contamination with faeces.
cauliflower.favourable_conditions: Warm dry spells during winter cultivation.
cauliflower.management: Spray Bt @ 2g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2ml/L.
cauliflower.prevention: Plant mustard trap crop borders; pheromone traps @ 5/acre.

carrot.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars feed voraciously on feathery carrot leaves from margins inwards.
carrot.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.
carrot.prevention: Handpick caterpillars; destroy crop residues after harvest.

beetroot.damage_symptoms: Leaves webbed together with fine silken threads; caterpillars skeletonize foliage inside web.
beetroot.favourable_conditions: Warm humid weather, weedy field conditions.
beetroot.management: Spray Malathion 50% EC @ 2ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
beetroot.prevention: Remove alternate weed hosts (Amaranthus spp.); clean cultivation.

banana.damage_symptoms: Tiny pinhole punctures on pseudostem exuding transparent jelly-like gum; internal tunneling leads to lodging under wind pressure.
banana.favourable_conditions: Over-aged plantations, poorly drained soils, neglected clumps.
banana.management: Stem injection of Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2.5ml/L or Swab pseudostem with Carbaryl 50% WP (2g/L); apply entomopathogenic fungus Beauveria bassiana.
banana.prevention: Use clean tissue culture plantlets; longitudinal split pseudostem traps (20/acre) laced with Beauveria.

banana.damage_symptoms: Aphids congregate in leaf axils; exclusive vector of deadly Banana Bunchy Top Virus (BBTV).
banana.favourable_conditions: High relative humidity with moderate temperature.
banana.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
banana.management: Inject pseudostem with Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1ml/tree or spray leaf axils with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L.
banana.prevention: Use virus-indexed certified tissue culture plants; eradicate bunchy top affected mats immediately.

mango.damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck sap from panicles causing them to wither and dry (blossom blight); honeydew covers leaves with black sooty mold.
mango.favourable_conditions: Cloudy overcast weather during flowering (January-March) in South India.
mango.affected_diseases: Predisposes panicles to anthracnose and sooty mold
mango.management: First spray at panicle emergence: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.25g/L; second spray at pea stage: Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L.
mango.prevention: Prune dense inner crisscross branches to admit sunlight; avoid spraying at full bloom to conserve pollinating honeybees.

mango.damage_symptoms: Oviposition punctures with dark liquid exudate; internal pulp consumed by maggots causing fruit rotting and drop.
mango.management: Install methyl eugenol pheromone traps @ 6-8/acre; bait spray of protein hydrolysate + Malathion 50% EC.
mango.prevention: Hot water treatment of harvested fruits (48°C for 60 min); collect and bury fallen fruits.

papaya.damage_symptoms: Thick white cottony mealybug wax clusters on leaves and fruits; leaf crinkling, fruit distortion, and heavy sooty mold.
papaya.favourable_conditions: Warm dry climate, absence of natural parasitoids.
papaya.management: Release exotic parasitoid Acerophagus papayae @ 100-250 per village/field; spray Profenofos 50% EC @ 2ml/L or Buprofezin 25% SC @ 1.5ml/L.
papaya.prevention: Eradicate alternate weed hosts (Parthenium hysterophorus); avoid moving infested planting material.

pomegranate.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into developing fruits; entry holes plugged with offensive-smelling faecal frass; fruit rots and drops.
pomegranate.favourable_conditions: Flowering and fruiting season (mrig / hasta bahar).
pomegranate.management: Bag individual fruits with butter paper or non-woven fabric bags (10-15 days after fruit set); spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
pomegranate.prevention: Clip and destroy infested fruits; release Trichogramma chilonis @ 100,000/ha.

guava.damage_symptoms: Necrotic angular brown spots on leaves; corky scab-like encrustations and cracking on fruits.
guava.favourable_conditions: Humid monsoon weather, dense shaded orchards.
guava.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Malathion 50% EC @ 2ml/L.
guava.prevention: Prune dense canopies; monitor terminal shoots at early flush.

sapota.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars bore into buds, webbing them together; damaged buds shed, drastically reducing fruit set.
sapota.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L at bud emergence.
sapota.prevention: Collect and destroy dropped buds; prune dried twigs.

pineapple.damage_symptoms: Fluffy white colonies at plant base; causes mealybug wilt leading to flaccid, bronze-red wilted leaves and root rot.
pineapple.favourable_conditions: Warm humid coastal conditions, attending ant populations.
pineapple.cause_relationship: Pest vectors and transmits plant pathogenic virus
pineapple.management: Dip suckers in Chlorpyrifos 20% EC (2.5ml/L) before planting; spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L around base.
pineapple.prevention: Control attending ants with bund band spraying; use disease-free suckers.

grapes.damage_symptoms: Adults feed voraciously on emerging buds after October pruning, preventing shoot emergence; leaves riddled with shot holes.
grapes.favourable_conditions: October pruning period in Peninsular India.
grapes.management: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L immediately after bud burst.
grapes.prevention: Remove loose bark on arms and stem during pruning; deep raking around vine trunk.

grapes.damage_symptoms: Cottony white wax covering bunches; berries crack, dry, and become coated in sticky sooty mold.
grapes.management: Release predatory ladybird beetle Cryptolaemus montrouzieri @ 1500/ha; spray Buprofezin 25% SC @ 1.5ml/L.
grapes.prevention: Debark vines after pruning; apply sticky bands around main trunk.

jackfruit.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into tender shoots and developing fruits, leaving prominent holes filled with dark gummy frass.
jackfruit.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L during early fruit set.
jackfruit.prevention: Bag fruits with nylon mesh bags; remove and destroy infested fruits.

watermelon.damage_symptoms: Sunken brown puncture spots exuding fluid; internal rotting with maggots.
watermelon.management: Install cue-lure traps @ 10/acre; bait spray of Malathion 50% EC (2ml) + Jaggery (10g) / L.
watermelon.prevention: Field sanitation; collect and bury dropped fruits.

muskmelon.damage_symptoms: Puncture spots on rind; internal tunneling by larvae resulting in premature fruit rot.
muskmelon.management: Install cue-lure pheromone traps; bait spray of jaggery + Malathion.
muskmelon.prevention: Bury infested fruits deeply; avoid continuous cucurbit cropping.

citrus_lime.damage_symptoms: Young caterpillars resemble bird droppings; mature caterpillars feed voraciously on leaves, completely defoliating seedlings and nursery stock.
citrus_lime.management: Hand collection of caterpillars in small gardens/nurseries; spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2g/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L.
citrus_lime.prevention: Install light traps; spray neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L on young flushes.

citrus_lime.damage_symptoms: Silvery serpentine winding mines on lower leaf surface; leaves curl and crinkle; provides entry points for Citrus Canker bacterium.
citrus_lime.favourable_conditions: Warm humid weather during new flush emergence.
citrus_lime.cause_relationship: Pest wounds predispose and facilitate bacterial pathogen infection
citrus_lime.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or NSKE 5% at flush emergence.
citrus_lime.prevention: Prune off-season flushes; maintain synchronous flushing through irrigation scheduling.

arecanut.damage_symptoms: Bugs suck sap from unexpanded spindle leaf; opened leaflets show brown necrotic linear patches and shot holes; stunted palm growth.
arecanut.favourable_conditions: Humid monsoon climate in Western Ghats and coastal belt.
arecanut.management: Spray or place Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L directly into innermost leaf axils.
arecanut.prevention: Regular cleaning of palm crowns; avoid heavy intercrop shading.

cashew.affected_plant_part: Flushing shoots, panicles, immature nuts, apples
cashew.damage_symptoms: Necrotic angular brown lesions on leaves and shoots; blossom blight where panicles dry up like scorched by fire; fruit drop.
cashew.management: Sequential spray schedule: 1st spray at flushing with Lambda-cyhalothrin 5% EC @ 0.6ml/L; 2nd at flowering with Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.5g/L; 3rd at fruit set.
cashew.prevention: Prune dead twigs after harvest; monitor canopy weekly.

cashew.damage_symptoms: Extrusion of reddish-brown fibrous frass and gum at base; yellowing and drying of canopy; tree death.
cashew.management: Chisel out grubs from trunk; swab trunk with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 10ml/L or Carbaryl 50% WP @ 20g/L.
cashew.prevention: Swab trunk with coal tar + kerosene (1:2) up to 1 meter; avoid mechanical trunk injury.

tea.damage_symptoms: Circular brown water-soaked spots which turn dark black and dry; leaves curl up and shoots dry (inverted cup symptom).
tea.favourable_conditions: Cloudy damp weather, shaded bush pockets.
tea.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.25g/L or Bifenthrin 8% SC @ 1ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L (strict adherence to CIBRC & PPC tea regulations).
tea.prevention: Maintain regular shear plucking; prune out shade trees to avoid excessive darkness.

tea.damage_symptoms: Bronze or rusty brown discoloration along midrib and main veins; leaf dullness, heavy defoliation during dry weather.
tea.favourable_conditions: Hot dry weather (December-April in South Indian tea hills).
tea.management: Spray Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 0.8ml/L or Propargite 57% EC @ 2ml/L or Wettable Sulphur 80% WP @ 2g/L.
tea.prevention: Foliar water misting; avoid roadside dust pollution over tea canopies.

rubber.damage_symptoms: Silken webbing ribbons containing wood frass and excreta on bark; tunnels bored into wood disrupt latex tapping.
rubber.management: Clean webbing and inject Quinalphos 25% EC (2ml/L) or Kerosene into hole and plug with wet mud.
rubber.prevention: Regular bark inspection; maintain weed sanitation around rubber base.
rubber.source: Rubber Research Institute of India (RRII) Kottayam

cocoa.affected_plant_part: Tender flush, flower cushions, cherelles, developing pods
cocoa.damage_symptoms: Dark necrotic spots on pods; cherelles wither and dry up (cherelle wilt); pod surface develops scab-like encrustations.
cocoa.favourable_conditions: High canopy shade, monsoon and post-monsoon seasons.
cocoa.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L at cherelle formation.
cocoa.prevention: Prune excessive cocoa branches; regulate overhead shade in coconut/arecanut gardens.

oil_palm.damage_symptoms: Geometric V-shaped cuts on newly opened fronds; holes bored into spear leaf base.
oil_palm.favourable_conditions: Adjacent decomposing organic matter, rotting palm logs.
oil_palm.management: Place naphthalene balls (10g) in upper leaf axils; apply Metarhizium anisopliae to organic compost pits.
oil_palm.prevention: Plant cover crops (Mucuna bracteata); pheromone traps (Oryctalure @ 1/ha).

palmyrah.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars build silken galleries on leaf undersides and scrape green chlorophyll, giving a burnt, scorched grey appearance.
palmyrah.management: Release larval parasitoids Goniozus nephantidis @ 20.5% and Bracon brevicornis; root feeding with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 10ml + 10ml water.
palmyrah.prevention: Cut and burn severely infested bottom fronds.

black_pepper.damage_symptoms: Adults scrape leaves; grubs bore into berries and hollow them out, turning them into dry empty shells (pollu berries).
black_pepper.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L in June-July and October; or spray Neemgold 0.5%.
black_pepper.prevention: Regulate overhead shade on standards; rake soil around vine base.

black_pepper.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars bore into growing terminal shoots causing shoot tip wilting and dieback.
black_pepper.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L on new shoots.

cardamom.damage_symptoms: Rasping on capsules produces corky encrustations, scabs, and shedding of flowers; infested capsules fetch low commercial grade.
cardamom.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L on panicles.
cardamom.prevention: Regular cleaning of clumps (de-trashing) before onset of flowering.

cardamom.damage_symptoms: Bore holes on pseudostem plugged with frass; central leaf dries (dead heart); capsules bored with hollow seeds.
cardamom.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L.
cardamom.prevention: Remove alternate hosts (castor, wild ginger) near plantations.

turmeric.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into pseudostem; central leaf dries up producing dead hearts; bore hole shows frass exudation.
turmeric.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L at 21-day intervals.
turmeric.prevention: Prune and destroy dead-heart shoots; avoid growing castor nearby.

ginger.damage_symptoms: Bore holes on pseudostem with protruding frass; central shoots yellow and dry up forming dead hearts.
ginger.management: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L.
ginger.prevention: Rogue out and burn dead-heart tillers; clean seed rhizomes.

clove.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore circular tunnels in wood, covered with coarse mat of wood particles and silk; branches wither and snap.
clove.management: Clear webbing and inject Quinalphos 25% EC (2ml/L) or Kerosene into hole and seal with mud.
clove.prevention: Regular stem inspection; maintain orchard sanitation.

coriander.damage_symptoms: Colonies suck sap from tender shoots and flowering umbels; umbels dry up and fail to set seed; heavy honeydew.
coriander.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or NSKE 5%.
coriander.prevention: Install yellow sticky traps; timely sowing in October.

cumin.damage_symptoms: Sap suction results in stunted umbels, yellowing, poor seed formation, and black sooty mold.
cumin.management: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3g/L at aphid appearance.
cumin.prevention: Early sowing to avoid peak aphid flight; yellow sticky traps.

fenugreek.damage_symptoms: Leaves curl and yellow; stunted pods with poor seed development.
fenugreek.management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5ml/L or Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
fenugreek.prevention: Conserve predatory ladybird beetles; early planting.

betel_vine.damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults puncture tender leaves; necrotic angular brown punctures develop making leaves unfit for market.
betel_vine.favourable_conditions: High relative humidity inside closed betelvine conservatory (bareja).
betel_vine.management: Spray Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L or Malathion 50% EC @ 1.5ml/L (observe 15-day pre-harvest interval).
betel_vine.prevention: Regulate shade and ventilation in conservatory; avoid water stagnation.

tamarind.damage_symptoms: Caterpillars bore into maturing pods; internal pulp and seeds damaged and filled with granular excreta.
tamarind.favourable_conditions: Dry warm climate during pod maturation.
tamarind.management: Spray Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L during pod development.
tamarind.prevention: Collect and destroy fallen infested pods; clean harvest.
